scope: Retrospective classical cross-fitted residual-ridge measurement update; specified after prior diagnostics, not a new theory, preregistration, prospective or independent validation.
prior: Frozen ChemicalKernelInputs Kprior; separate human and rat outputs. Each reference held compound is excluded from both nuisance fitting and its alpha selection. All preprocessing is local to each nuisance training fold.
adapter: Reference OOF E_S=S-predS and E_H=H-predH; train-only column-standardized E_S, linear kernel divided by all source genes, ridge alpha1 with mean(E_H) intercept b.
deployment: Final human/rat priors each select alpha using three inner folds of all outer-training compounds. Test innovation is observed rat response minus final rat prior; no test human response enters prediction.
gamma: Prediction=human_prior+b+gamma*f(E_S). gamma1 is primary; gamma0 equals bias-only exactly; gamma0.5 is fixed sensitivity. Gamma never changes after outer scores.
primary_comparison: bias_only compound-macro full-gene MSE minus residual_gamma1 MSE; positive means source-dependent gain beyond the training residual mean.
secondary_comparisons: gamma1 vs same-input direct source/prior fusion

molecular_features.join: Case-fold, underscores to spaces, whitespace collapse; no chemical alias inference.
molecular_features.selection_basis: Verified reagent identity and feature availability only; no response values.

data_warnings: Condition-level replicate means do not retain single-cell distributions or replicate variance (Zenodo 20204514).
Historical RMA jointly normalized all available arrays per species before splitting; this pilot remains exploratory and retrospective (source 41a_rma_brainarray.R).
Historical test outcomes have been examined in prior repository analyses; diagnostic_test is not a prospective or untouched test set (artifacts/tg_gates_rat_human_v1/report.md).
Before absolute-concentration filtering: Dose units are missing for retained conditions; equal dose labels or numeric values do not establish concentration matching.
Before absolute-concentration filtering: Nominal concentration comparison is unknown for 100 retained conditions; unsupported units are not concentration matched.
Absolute-concentration retained cohort has zero unknown/ambiguous units; both arms receive planned nominal molar concentrations.
interval_scope: Compound bootstrap of frozen OOF predictions; overlapping outer/reference training induces dependence, without model refitting or donor uncertainty. Percentile population coverage is not established.
limitations: OOF nuisance priors use two thirds of outer training compounds, whereas deployment priors use all outer training compounds; innovation/error distributions may shift.
One animal species, one broad liver system, historical joint RMA and averaged profiles remain applicable.
The method is classical residual ridge. A runnable update chain does not establish a new optimization method or guarantee positive transfer.

absolute_concentrations.rule: Both planned treatment doses must be finite and positive with uniquely resolved attributes/metadata units among M,mM,uM,μM,nM. Case-sensitive fixed conversion to M followed by log10; no inferred units, mass-to-molar conversion, aliases, or rounding.
absolute_concentrations.information_available_to_both_arms: Time, planned rat concentration, planned human concentration, nominal dose indicators and molecular features. Source-plus-prior alone additionally receives measured rat expression response.
absolute_concentrations.interpretation: Nominal administered molar concentrations; intracellular exposure equivalence is not established. Different verified source/target concentrations are retained.
